pipeline.materialization: Nine serialized, full-state, source/destination SHA-256 verified North-to-East transfers, including initialization and four-rank data-order sidecars.
pipeline.integrity: One joint gate over all nine runs; checks fixed step 20000, full config, optimizer state, initialization equality within seed, exact rank data-order equality within seed, distinct data order across seeds, in_order=true, and num_workers=8.
pipeline.evaluation: Nine independent four-GPU East jobs under the unchanged 24-cell paired RoboTwin protocol.
pipeline.analysis: No analysis or TG3 admission until all nine evaluations pass their exact 24-summary completion gates.

invariants: A successful platform terminal state and durable final model are both required before materialization.
No parameter-only checkpoint shortcut is permitted; optimizer state remains part of the integrity contract.
No original rejected TG2 checkpoint or evaluation result may be substituted for a TG2R cell.
The original TG2 scientific stop rules and evaluation scene manifest remain unchanged.
